settings.about_content:
HalalLens is a next-generation AI-powered Halal verification assistant designed for modern Muslim consumers. In an age of complex global food supply chains, identifying truly Halal products can be challenging. Our app combines advanced artificial intelligence with a massive global database to simplify this process.

Key Features:
• Advanced AI Analysis: We use the latest Llama 3 Vision and Text models from Groq AI to analyze ingredients in real time.
• Global Database: Access product data for over 3 million products worldwide through Open Food Facts.
• Multi-Language Support: Switch seamlessly between 14 major languages.
• Vision OCR: No barcode? Take a photo of the ingredient list and our AI will translate and analyze it instantly.
• Speed: Get results in milliseconds thanks to Groq's high-performance AI infrastructure.

Our mission is to empower Muslims globally with transparency, making Halal shopping faster, safer and 100% reliable.
settings.help_content:
Need help or have suggestions? The HalalLens team is committed to giving you the best experience.

Common Support Topics:
• Reporting incorrect results: AI can sometimes make mistakes. If you see a wrong status for a product, please email us the barcode.
• Product not found: If a product is not in the database, you can use the 'Ingredient Scan' feature to manually analyze the label.
• Technical issues: If the app runs slowly, check your internet connection, as AI features require cloud processing.

Contact Us:
• Email: support@halallens.com
• Website: www.halallens.com
• FAQ: Visit our help center at halallens.com/faq

We typically respond to emails within 24–48 hours. Your feedback helps us improve HalalLens for everyone!
settings.privacy_content:
At HalalLens we believe your privacy is your right. We have designed this app with a 'Privacy-First' architecture.

Core pillars of privacy:
1. Zero personal tracking: We do not require any account registration. We do not collect your name, email or location.
2. Local data: Your scan history and saved products are stored only on your device. We have no way to see what you scan.
3. Secure AI: Images sent for analysis are processed through private APIs. No data is stored permanently.
4. Minimal permissions: We only need camera access for scanning. We do not access your contacts or other personal files.

Your trust is our greatest asset.
